generations.name: panel-card
generations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a standalone blank UI dialog card for a bright cute bubble-shooter mobile game. One square milk-white card on genuine transparent background, front-facing, axis-aligned, no perspective. Intended final asset 360×360. Clean lightweight softly shaded surface, very gentle vertical gradient from creamy white at top to extremely pale icy blue at bottom. A SINGLE thin 2–3 px pale sky-blue outline, a very faint white inner rim, and soft subtle cool shadow contained entirely inside canvas in an 8–10 px outer margin. No thick frame, no glass reflection streaks, no bubbles, no text or symbols, no dramatic shine. Geometry is critical for 9-slice: card outer contour starts about 8 px inside the canvas; round corners with radius about 38–40 px, never above 48 px; all curves and shadow turn within the first/last 48 px of the 360 px canvas. Long perfectly straight horizontal/vertical sides between corner caps. Blank broad calm uniform center, no ornamentation. These are proportions of the intended 360×360 export; render at high quality. Transparent outside the card and its faint shadow.

generations.name: icon-music
generations.prompt:
Game UI asset for a bright, cute bubble-shooter mobile game, glossy candy-jelly style, soft cel shading, white highlight top-left, clean darker same-hue outline, transparent background, no text.
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone settings icon, intended final export 128×128 PNG with transparent background. References 1 (bubbles), 2 (clock), and 3 (star) are style references only: match their rounded inflated jelly volume, clear dark same-hue edging, smooth shading and a small white top-left shine. Create the requested new symbol, do not copy their subjects. Straight-on centered icon, generous recognizable silhouette filling about 86% of a square canvas, fully inside image with transparent padding. Use shades of sky blue and violet, readable on a milk-white card even at 32×32. No text, letters, numbers, extra badges, unrelated decorations, backdrop, or enclosing button.
Subject: one clear pair of connected eighth notes (two round note heads, two thick stems joined by a single beam), made of plump purple-violet jelly with lavender lighting and deeper violet outline. Friendly rounded ends and clean negative space. Large connected music-note silhouette, no other objects.

panel_edit.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached blank UI panel only. Preserve its square shape, thin pale sky-blue single outline, very faint inner white rim, rounded corners, transparent exterior, and contained soft outer shadow. Change only the face gradient: the current lower half is too saturated blue. Make the face a much quieter barely-blue white card: top creamy white around #FFFCF7, middle #F5FAFD, bottom very pale icy blue #EDF6FD. It should read primarily white all across the surface, lightweight and clean. No new shine streaks, glass bars, ornaments, text, symbols, extra borders or bubbles. Keep straight sides and corner curves within 48/360 of the square canvas for nine-slice stretching; all shadows inside the image. Keep true transparent background.
panel_edit.reason: Reduce blue saturation of the lower card face to better match the requested cream-white to very pale blue gradient.

Shared white top-left highlights and darker same-hue outlines.

Card face reviewed as creamy white to very pale blue, thin cyan rim, faint inner white highlight, soft contained shadow.

scope: Only new art, native generation archives, and records produced. No source code, existing art, atlas, game build, or deployment changed by this task.
